payload.title: The publication layout preset: sectioned tiers, hamburger nav with subtitles, slots
payload.description:
What: a core layout preset for tiered sectioned listings, hamburger nav with subtitles, and spine and ornament slots. Home templates are chosen from a short list (PPY-1b83d3 home page work feeds this).
Acceptance:
Scenario: A site picks the preset in configuration only
  Given projection and brand pack with no hooks
  When the site builds
  Then home, section, item, wiki and 404 pages render in the preset
